notes.title: Patch 1.02
notes.content:
A small patch has been released:

-Fixed leaning
-Added collisions to stairs on [b]School Courtyard[/b]

notes.title: First Patch 1.01
notes.content:
Hello everyone, we heard your feedbacks about the game and we will continue making it better!

Fixes and changes in this patch:

-Added Russian subtitles
-Added background buildings
-Removed an invisible wall to the left entrance in [b]School Backyard[/b]
-Fixed diary and note texts
-Fixed bug with getting stuck at the front doors
-Minor fixes
